UseCases.section_title: Questions that deserve a judgment-free answer
UseCases.section_description: Write in your own words, without fear of anyone's reaction. Aliada answers calmly, with clear information and respect.
UseCases.couples_description: Questions about hormones, expected effects, timelines, follow-up and how to talk about it with your doctor or family.
UseCases.couples_example: “I started estrogen 3 months ago. Which changes are normal and which should I get checked?”
UseCases.creators_description: STIs, PrEP and PEP, contraception, safer practices, symptoms and when to see a doctor, explained without shame.
UseCases.creators_example: “I had unprotected sex 2 days ago. What are my options and how urgent is it?”
UseCases.friends_description: A place to sort out what you feel, understand the terms and prepare for hard conversations at your own pace.
UseCases.friends_example: “I think I'm non-binary but don't know how to tell my parents. Where do I start?”
UseCases.roleplay_description: Anxiety, dysphoria, family rejection or loneliness: empathetic support and resources, without replacing a professional.
UseCases.roleplay_example: “Dysphoria is hitting hard today. I need to talk to someone who won't judge me.”
UseCases.writers_description: What they involve, preparation, recovery and the key questions to ask your medical team before deciding.
UseCases.writers_example: “What should I ask at my first consultation for gender-affirming top surgery?”
UseCases.marketing_description: For parents, partners and friends who want to be there for someone and don't know how to ask.
UseCases.marketing_example: “My son told me he's trans. I want to support him well: what should I know and what should I avoid?”

HowItWorks.section_description: No international cards or setup. Create your account, try it free and pay with PayPhone when you want more.
HowItWorks.step1_description: Sign up with your email or Google. It's free, takes 30 seconds and nobody else sees your activity.
HowItWorks.step2_title: Try free or activate a plan
HowItWorks.step2_description: Your new account includes a free trial. When you want more, pay Premium ($19) or VIP ($39) with PayPhone and your plan is active instantly for 30 days.
HowItWorks.step3_description: In the dashboard pick Text to talk or Image if you need visual support material.
HowItWorks.step4_description: Describe your situation in detail and press Generate. You'll see your usage in the dashboard bars.
HowItWorks.tip1: Give context: age, how long since you started a treatment, symptoms and since when.
HowItWorks.tip2: Ask what you don't dare to ask in a consultation: nobody judges or interrupts you here.
HowItWorks.tip3: If an answer isn't clear, ask for a simpler explanation or examples.
HowItWorks.tip4: Aliada informs and supports you but does not replace your doctor. In an emergency, go to a health service.

FAQ.question1: Does Aliada really answer without filters?
FAQ.answer1: Yes. We use models without corporate censorship, so you can ask about hormones, surgeries, sexual practices or identity and get clear, respectful information.
FAQ.answer2: With PayPhone, using your PayPhone balance or any card. Premium costs $19 and VIP $39; both last 30 days. You can try it free first.
FAQ.answer3: No. Nothing is charged automatically. When your 30 days end you decide whether to pay again.
FAQ.answer4: Your conversations are processed privately, never used to train models and never sold to third parties.
FAQ.answer5: No. Aliada informs you, supports you and helps you prepare for consultations, but diagnosis and treatment belong to your health professional. In an emergency, go to a medical service.
FAQ.question6: What happens if my payment fails?
FAQ.answer6: Nothing is charged. You can retry from your dashboard or write to us at support.

sections.title: 1. What Aliada AI is
body: Aliada AI is an artificial-intelligence tool providing educational and informational support on intimate health, sexual health, gender transition, identity and emotional wellbeing.
Responses are generated automatically by language and image models. They may contain errors, inaccuracies or outdated information. Aliada AI does not individually review each response.

sections.title: 2. Not a medical service
body: Aliada AI does NOT provide medical services, does not issue diagnoses, does not prescribe treatments or doses and does not replace consultation with a healthcare professional. No doctor-patient relationship exists between you and Aliada AI, its founder or its team.

Any decision about hormones, medication, procedures or surgery must be discussed with and made by your endocrinologist or treating physician. In a medical emergency or emotional crisis, contact your country's emergency services or a helpline immediately.
You are solely responsible for how you use the information obtained through the Service.

sections.title: 3. Age requirement
body: The Service is exclusively for people aged 18 or older. By using it you confirm you meet that age. We may suspend accounts we reasonably believe belong to minors.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
body: You agree not to use the Service to generate sexual content involving minors, content depicting real people without their consent, content inciting violence, hatred or self-harm, or for any illegal activity.
Model providers may reject certain prompts. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that breach these rules, without refund.

sections.title: 5. Plans, payments and quotas
body: The Free plan includes a one-time trial quota. Premium and VIP plans are prepaid through PayPhone, grant access for 30 days and a monthly quota of images and text shown on the pricing page. There is no automatic renewal.
Payments are non-refundable once the plan is activated, except for a technical error attributable to us that completely prevents use of the Service.
Quotas may be adjusted to keep the Service sustainable; we will give reasonable notice.

sections.title: 6. Generated content
body: You are responsible for the prompts you submit and for how you use generated content. To the extent permitted by law, content you generate is yours. We do not guarantee its originality or fitness for a particular purpose.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
body: The Service is provided "as is". To the maximum extent permitted by law, Aliada AI, its founder and collaborators shall not be liable for direct or indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the Service, nor for health decisions made based on its content.
In any event, total liability is limited to the amount you paid in the last 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Changes and governing law
body: We may update these terms; the current version will always be published on this page. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Ecuador.

Privacy.meta_description: What data Aliada AI processes, why, and how we protect it.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Your privacy is the foundation of Aliada AI. Here we explain clearly what data we process, why, and how you can exercise your rights.
Privacy.contact: To exercise your rights or ask privacy questions, write to

sections.title: 1. Data we process
body: Account: the email address and name you register when signing in; managed by our authentication provider (Clerk).
Payments: transaction ID, plan, amount and payment status processed by PayPhone. We never see or store your card details.
Usage: counters of images and tokens consumed per period to enforce your plan's quotas.
Prompts and responses: sent to our AI model provider to generate the response and shown on your screen. We currently do not store a history of your conversations or images in our database.

sections.title: 2. Why we use it
body: To provide the Service, manage your subscription, enforce quotas and prevent abuse. We do not use your conversations to train models, we do not build advertising profiles and we do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Providers
body: We use providers that process data on our behalf: Clerk (authentication), PayPhone (payments), Vercel (hosting), Neon (database) and an AI inference provider with a no-prompt-retention policy. Each is bound by its own privacy terms and by our instructions.

sections.title: 4. Sensitive data
body: When using Aliada AI you may share information about your health, sexual orientation or gender identity. We process that information solely to generate the response you request. We recommend not including real names, documents or data that could identify you or third parties in your prompts.

sections.title: 5. Retention
body: Account, payment and usage data are kept while your account is active and for as long as required to meet legal and accounting obligations. You can request deletion of your account at any time.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
body: You may access, rectify, delete your data and object to its processing under Ecuador's Organic Law on Personal Data Protection and applicable regulations. We will respond within 15 days.

sections.title: 7. Security
body: All communication is encrypted (HTTPS). Database access is restricted and credentials are managed securely. No system is infallible; if we detect a breach affecting you, we will notify you.

sections.title: 8. Changes
body: We may update this policy; the current version will always be published on this page with its update date.
